title: Sports Jerseys
heroAlt: Sports team in matching navy and gold sublimated jerseys
summary: Sublimated jerseys and sets for clubs, tournaments and academies.
intro: Sublimation bonds dye into polyester fibre, so the design cannot crack, peel or fade the way a surface print eventually will. That makes it the right method for jerseys carrying full-surface artwork, names and numbers.
considerations: Individual names and numbers do not add a per-piece plate cost under sublimation.
Full-surface designs need artwork supplied as vector or at high resolution.
Team orders are usually 11–40 pieces, which is why our minimum is 10.
